  "phoneNote": "The license plate phone CTA and hazard-stripe yellow band give the site a memorable workshop character, but the address, opening hours, and directions link are repeated three times down the page.",
  "desktopNote": "The bold industrial typography and license plate motif work well, though the 'Kako poteka popravilo' section leaves the right half of the screen completely empty.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the redundant white 'Obiščite nas / Delovni čas' block at the bottom, as the exact same address and hours are already inside the yellow contact section right above it.",
    "Drop the repeated 'Navodila za pot' text link inside the hero section since it is already prominent in the top header and the yellow info bar immediately below.",
    "On desktop, arrange the 3 steps in 'Kako poteka popravilo' horizontally across 3 columns or place a workshop photo on the right to balance the empty half of the screen."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On phone, the 'Obiščite nas' and 'Delovni čas' block at the bottom repeats the exact same address, hours, and directions link already shown in the yellow contact block directly above it."
